items.title: File Einspruch (tax objection) against amended assessment
items.quote: Er ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterstadt-Nord schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 11.06.2026, sent by simple post. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter posted by an authority is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 15.06.2026 (the letter itself states this rule). Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (15.06.) is not counted; the one-month period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) runs from 16.06.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day it started counting relative to delivery, i.e. Wed 15.07.2026. That day is a normal working day (no weekend/NW holiday), so no shift applies (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).
